fe4d9468ae4e40dcb5651aa503ea997a.opening: The Indian Health Service (IHS), Great Plains Area, is soliciting proposals for non-personal Emergency Department Registered Nurse services in support of the Standing Rock Service Unit, Fort Yates Hospital, Fort Yates, North Dakota, under Solicitation No. 75H70627R00002. The requirement is for up to eight (8) qualified Emergency Department Registered Nurse positions to support continuous 24-hour, 7-day-per-week Emergency Department operations. The anticipated contract type is Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP), commercial services, with one four (4)-month Base Period and fourteen (14) four-month Option Periods, for a total potential period of performance of sixty (60) months. This acquisition is set aside 100 percent for eligible Indian Small Business Economic Enterprises (ISBEEs) in accordance with the Buy Indian Act and applicable HHSAR requirements. The applicable NAICS code is 561320, Temporary Help Services, and the Product Service Code is Q401, Medical Nursing. d20f40fe98fe4b02b6a8fc3251265f83.support_context: The U.S. Department of State (DOS) has a requirement for a qualified Contractor to provide Local Guard Services to support the U.S. Mission United Arab Emirates (UAE) in Abu Dhabi and Dubai.
d20f40fe98fe4b02b6a8fc3251265f83.opening: The U.S. Department of State (DOS) has a requirement for a qualified Contractor to provide Local Guard Services to support the U.S. Mission United Arab Emirates (UAE) in Abu Dhabi and Dubai. The Government requires a secure environment to conduct their mission. The Contractor shall provide the organizational structure, management, and qualified staff at levels adequate to meet or exceed the requirement contained in the Performance Work Statement. The Contractor shall be required to provide services in a manner that prevent loss or injury to U.S. personnel, dependents, property; destruction of assets; to prevent unauthorized access; and deter potential terrorist attacks. Anticipated period of performance is for one base year and four one-year options (to be exercised at the sole discretion of the Government). See attached 19AQMM27R0019 for more details. Offerors are required to provide a signed Restricted Access Request (RAR) form to the POC prior to requesting access in sams.gov in order to view the solicitation and all correlating documents. The RAR and further details of obtaining access to secure solicitation documents can be found in History/Related Notice - PR15904172-Pre-soli

b75232e01627477ba024adc55fa2e5e9.opening: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineer (USACE), Philadelphia District (NAP), anticipates a requirement for the Chesapeake and Delaware (C and D) Canal Building Replacement Project. The Chesapeake and Delaware or Canal connects the Delaware River to the Chesapeake Bay and Port of Baltimore. The canal is maintained from a field office located in Chesapeake City Maryland. This office consists of multiple buildings and shops that are essential to the continued operation of the canal. Several of these building have reached the end of their lifecycle and need to be replaced. This project will include the demolition and consolidation of the mechanics shop, bridge shop and storage buildings. A new building will be constructed to sever as a replacement of the buildings that are being removed. The building will be located along the east side of the project site. The building dimensions will be 60 feet x 150 feet with a clear ceiling height of 20 feet. The building will have a gable roof with the ridge running parallel to the length of the building. A pre- engineered metal building with tapered columns will be used. The columns will be enclosed with steel stud framing and gypsum board in the office

8f25163f92414f3fb539446fa926f000.support_sentence: Provide a single contractor with management responsibility for the entire population of replacement parts supporting DLRs.
8f25163f92414f3fb539446fa926f000.support_context: The Government has determined that to be successful this contract strategy must: Allow the contractor to leverage the Government s buying power for consumable parts, while streamlining and improving the purchase process. Provide a single contractor with management responsibility for the entire population of replacement parts supporting DLRs. Improve forecasting and inventory accuracy Provide relief for single-point process bottlenecks (e.g., plating, grinding) within the organic depot Provide remanufacture support for all DLRs beyond the throughput capacity of Government depot, to be fulfilled at the prime contractor s facility.

Scope The 417th Landing Gear Supply Chain Management Squadron (417 SCMS), Enterprise Hill Commodity Council (EHCC) and Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) are developing a strategy to support Ogden Air Logistics Complex (OO-ALC) Depot production goals associated with the B-52, C-5, C-130, KC-135, and E-3 platforms. This strategy will subsume the workload currently supported under the Landing Gear Performance Based Logistics (LG-PBL1) contract, while expanding support to the B-52 and C-5 platforms. bb647f16ca7f4cf6ad857e7f913be543.title: Repair of the B-52 CONECT
bb647f16ca7f4cf6ad857e7f913be543.support_sentence: The scope of services includes evaluation, fault isolation, remove and replace, inspection, testing, repair, and packaging of the below items: NSN 5821-01-657-6453CX PN: 7000386-19 NSN 5821-01-657-6452CX PN: 7000946-19 NSN 5821-01-664-4605CX PN: 73000053-19 1.2 Benefit to United States Air Force (USAF): This acquisition directly benefits the United States Air Force (USAF) by providing the serviceable assets necessary to sustain the B-52 CONECT system.
bb647f16ca7f4cf6ad857e7f913be543.support_context: The contractor shall provide timely and accurate reporting in Commercial Asset Visibility Air Force (CAVAF), while meeting the repair Turn Around Times (TAT) of routines, SURGE, and MICAP requirements and reduce the frequency of Product Quality deficiency Reports (PQDRs). The scope of services includes evaluation, fault isolation, remove and replace, inspection, testing, repair, and packaging of the below items: NSN 5821-01-657-6453CX PN: 7000386-19 NSN 5821-01-657-6452CX PN: 7000946-19 NSN 5821-01-664-4605CX PN: 73000053-19 1.2 Benefit to United States Air Force (USAF): This acquisition directly benefits the United States Air Force (USAF) by providing the serviceable assets necessary to sustain the B-52 CONECT system. This will ensure proper operation of CONECT components and significantly reduce Mission Incapable Awaiting Parts (MICAP) requisitions.
bb647f16ca7f4cf6ad857e7f913be543.opening: This is a notice of intent that WR-ALC anticipates soliciting and negotiating a Firm Fixed Price Indefinite Delivery Requirements contract and Cost-Plus Fixed Fee for engineering services, for a 5 Year contract (Basic + 4 ordering periods- out years), the purpose of this requirement is to encompass the repair of various B52 components. The following NSNs require repair- B-52 CONECT components for NSNs 5821016576453CX QTY 171, 5821016576452CX QTY 18, AND 5821016644605CX QTY 20. This effort is intended to be awarded to Honeywell Aerospace in accordance with FAR 6.103-1 - Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. Honeywell Aerospace, as one of the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the B52 CONECT, is the only company with expertise, equipment, technical data, and specialized skills that can repair these items. However, Interested Party or Person(s) may identify their interest and capability to respond to the requirement or submit a proposal(s).
